items.html: *On the matter of the difference that exists between the world of Atzilut, the world of Beriah, the world of Yetzirah, and the world of Assiyah. I have already informed you that the four worlds ABYA are included in the secret of the four letters of the HaVaYaH. I have also informed you that the four letters of the HaVaYaH divide in this order: the Yod is in Hochma, the Hey is in Bina, the Vav is in Tifferet, and the Hey is in Malchut. How so: the letter Yod is in Atzilut, and it is in the aspect of the HaVaYaH of Yudin, which amounts to 72, called Hochma, in the secret of "all of them You have made in wisdom," said of Atzilut, as is explained in its place.
